explication: This repository is an educational compendium spanning mathematics, computing, and AI, with an MCP server that exposes its material to AI assistants and browser-side tools for interactive learning. The main learner workflow is to study the chapter sequence and run Python examples in the browser. Chapter coverage is grouped into broad subject areas; the README documents the full outline, while the sampled server source shows topic listing, section reading, search, recommendations, and example extraction. Arrows reflect documented or excerpted behavior, not an assumed chapter-to-chapter pipeline.
